scenes.title: Gifts from Hungary
scenes.summary: 1980s flashback: Vanya Samsonov's father comes home to the communal flat from Hungary with presents (a tape recorder, chewing gum, toy cars) for the children; little Arkasha watches and is sent back to his homework.

scenes.title: Where's the Toy Car?
scenes.summary: Flashback: little Arkasha is caught with Vanya's toy car; Vanya and the other kids dunk his head in the shared toilet, and Arkasha swears that one day Vanya will beg his forgiveness.

scenes.title: A Second Term
scenes.summary: Today: Mayor Arkady Anikeev tells a crowd he grew up in a communal flat in Sineozersk and will run for a second term; reporters ask about rivals and the governor.
scenes.location: square in front of the town hall

scenes.title: The Monastery Wall
scenes.summary: Lecturer Marina Sergeyevna and her students protest that a medieval monastery wall is being pulled down for a shopping centre; Arkady blames his deputy Pasha, promises to save it and invites Marina onto a public council, then privately orders Pasha to silence her.
scenes.location: square in front of the town hall

scenes.title: An Emergency Meeting
scenes.summary: A woman Arkady calls 'Viktor Stepanovich' rings and wants to see him tonight; in front of his wife Vika he pretends it is an emergency meeting and says he will be working late.
scenes.location: Arkady's car / outside the town hall

scenes.title: An Old Acquaintance
scenes.summary: Ivan 'Samson' Samsonov, the bully from Arkady's childhood, visits the mayor's office to ask for a better job; Arkady is all smiles, offers him his boss's post and makes him phone the boss and quit rudely.

scenes.title: One Small Formality
scenes.summary: Arkady names his condition for the job: Samson must humiliate himself with a 'kiss', just as Arkasha promised when Samson dunked him in the toilet as a boy. Samson storms out; the offer stays open.

scenes.title: Coffee and the Cluster
scenes.summary: Next morning Arkady orders coffee from his secretary; deputy Pasha reports on the campaign and pushes a Moscow industrial 'cluster' deal, which Arkady refuses because it would poison the lakes; he mocks Pasha and dismisses him.

scenes.title: I Want to Go to the Sea!
scenes.summary: Samson begs his old boss for his job back and fails; at home his wife Nina says he should have accepted Arkady's humiliating offer: she is sick of the communal flat, its leaking pipe and the endless chores, and dreams of the sea.
scenes.location: Samsonovs' room in the communal flat

scenes.title: Plans for City Day
scenes.summary: Arkady phones an organiser about City Day: free beer, pop stars from Moscow, no expensive fireworks, all to win votes.

scenes.title: You Gave Your Word!
scenes.summary: Samson returns and agrees to the humiliating 'kiss' in front of the secretary; afterwards Arkady breaks his word, says the old boss stays, and sends Samson to the job centre.

scenes.title: A Call in the Car
scenes.summary: Driving through town, Arkady gets a call from businessman Arakelyan: the money for the shopping centre is ready, and he wants to meet right now in the Santa Fe café before flying to Yerevan.

scenes.title: Go and Hire Galileo
scenes.summary: At the university Marina tells the dean she has saved the monastery; the dean, under pressure from the town hall, asks her to drop it and hints at her job and her sick son; she refuses and walks out.

scenes.title: Freeze!
scenes.summary: Arkady finds Arakelyan hiding in a corner of the café; as the bag of money changes hands, investigators burst in and arrest the mayor for taking a very large bribe.

scenes.title: News on TV
scenes.summary: At home Nina scolds Samson for going through with the 'kiss' without even getting a receipt; then the TV news reports the mayor's arrest and that the court has put him under house arrest at his registered address.
scenes.location: Samsonovs' room in the communal flat

scenes.title: Home Again, with a Tag
scenes.summary: Prison-service officers bring Arkady to the communal flat where he is still registered; an old neighbour recognises him, his old room is found behind a wardrobe, and an officer fits an electronic tag to his ankle and explains the 50-metre rule.

scenes.title: One-All
scenes.summary: Arkady tells Samson it was only payback and asks for peace; Samson shakes on it and breaks his finger. Nina bandages it, and Samson announces that Arkady will now be the family's servant.

scenes.title: The Leaking Pipe
scenes.summary: Samson drags Arkady to the shared toilet and orders him to fix the leaking pipe; Arkady refuses and promises the family everything they want once he is free in two weeks. Nina demands it in writing.

scenes.title: The Wish List
scenes.summary: Arkady and the Samsonovs draw up the list: a three-room flat, a German car, a spa for Nina, a university place for Yulia; Samson threatens him if he cheats. Then Arkady's deputy arrives.

scenes.title: A White Cayenne
scenes.summary: Arkady's wife Vika and deputy Pasha arrive with his things; Arkady introduces everyone as one team and makes Vika hand Samson the keys of her white Porsche Cayenne. The family runs down to see it.

scenes.title: All the Money Is His Wife's
scenes.summary: Alone with Vika and Pasha, Arkady asks Pasha to make Arakelyan withdraw his statement; Pasha reveals he set up the arrest himself because Arkady blocked the cluster, and reminds him that all the money is in Vika's name.

scenes.title: Pasha and I
scenes.summary: Vika tells Arkady she has been with Pasha for a month and feels like a woman again; Arkady says Pasha only wants her money, she calls him a jerk and leaves, and Pasha smugly lists his plans: the election, the money, the cluster.

scenes.title: Dreams in the courtyard
scenes.summary: The Samsonovs admire the Cayenne in the courtyard and dream of driving to Crimea or Europe, until Vika politely asks for the keys back.

scenes.title: There's Your Kingdom
scenes.summary: Arkady admits he has nothing left: he has been cheated. Furious, Samson rips out the leaking pipe and floods the shared bathroom, shouting that this is Nina's 'kingdom'; Nina begs him to stop.

scenes.title: All Clean
scenes.summary: After the flood an old neighbour sighs, Samson promises Nina that Arkady will wash everything, Arkady scrubs the floor and politely shows the old neighbour how to hold the latchless toilet door shut, promising a latch tomorrow (she thanks 'the dear mayor' sarcastically), and Nina refuses to speak to Samson.

scenes.title: Pasha on TV
scenes.summary: Pasha announces on TV that he is running for mayor and will build the cluster; Arkady and Samson drink bad vodka in the kitchen, and Samson says all officials are thieves and nobody cares.

scenes.title: The New Mayor
scenes.summary: Arkady suddenly has an idea: he questions Samson (Russian, Orthodox, never in prison, two kids, served in the army) and tells him he will make him the new mayor, so together they can stop Pasha.

scenes.title: Why me?
scenes.summary: Nina complains on the phone that all the boys chased her at school and she still drew the short straw; the closing song asks how much money it takes to be happy.
scenes.location: Samsonovs' room in the communal flat
